correctness.rationale: Aut(Z)={±1}. Inversion plus g0*=g0 forces g0=1 and gives the standard just-infinite Chein double. Under the identity involution the rules reduce to [a,u]=1 and u^2=a^k, hence Z^2/<(-k,2)> and Smith normal form gives Z plus a gcd(2,k) torsion factor. Odd k gives Z; even k leaves a nontrivial finite normal C2 of infinite index.
correctness.risk: This classifies only the infinite cyclic base.

Loops of Bol-Moufang type with a subgroup of index two

value.rationale: This completely resolves the generalized loop-level question for the basic just-infinite abelian group, with an exact parity obstruction and explicit isomorphism type.

final_claim: For \(G=\langle a\rangle\cong\mathbb Z\), an admissible generalized Chein double is just-infinite exactly for the inversion case \(a^*=a^{-1},g_0=1\) or the identity-involution case \(g_0=a^k\) with odd \(k\); in the latter case the double is \(\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/\gcd(2,k)\mathbb Z\).
limitations: No extension to other abelian or nonabelian bases is claimed.
